name: Faucet Installation

faqs.question: How long does faucet installation take?
faqs.answer: Most faucet installations take 1-2 hours, depending on the complexity of the fixture and existing plumbing configuration.

faqs.question: Do I need to purchase the faucet before installation?
faqs.answer: You can purchase your own faucet or we can recommend and supply quality fixtures that fit your needs and budget.

faqs.question: Can you install faucets in older homes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly install faucets in older homes and can adapt to various plumbing configurations, including updating supply lines if needed.

faqs.question: What types of faucets do you install?
faqs.answer: We install all types including single-handle, double-handle, pull-down, touchless, and commercial-style kitchen faucets, plus bathroom sink and tub faucets.

faqs.question: Do you remove and dispose of old faucets?
faqs.answer: Yes, we remove your old faucet and dispose of it properly as part of our installation service.

description: Professional faucet installation services for kitchen and bathroom fixtures
